name: sku_code
definition: Company SKU code; master key for every step
help: Your internal product code, the key that joins every file

name: item_name
definition: Item name used for crosswalk matching and reports
help: Product name as it appears on the sales order

name: order_date
help: Date the sales order was raised

name: so_status
definition: Sales-order status; invoiced and confirmed are kept
help: Invoiced, confirmed, void or draft

name: customer_name
definition: ERP customer; mapped to a platform by customer rules
help: Buyer on the order; tells us the platform

name: ship_city
definition: Shipping city; mapped to a planning city
help: City the order ships to

name: qty_invoiced
help: Units billed to the customer

name: qty_cancelled
help: Units ordered but not shipped

name: qty_ordered
help: Units the customer ordered on the sales order

name: item_price
help: Price per unit charged to the customer

name: mrp
help: Maximum retail price per unit

name: branch_id
definition: ERP branch; detects the org-2 column shift
help: Your shipping branch in the ERP

name: so_id
help: Unique ID of the sales order in the ERP

name: so_number
help: Sales order number shown on documents

name: reference_no
help: Customer's reference, often their PO number

name: po_number
help: The platform's purchase order number

name: po_date
help: Date the platform raised the purchase order

name: po_status
help: Completed, expired, open or cancelled

name: facility
help: Platform fulfilment centre or warehouse

name: po_city
definition: PO city; mapped to a planning city
help: City of the warehouse the PO is for

name: platform_item_id
help: The platform's own ID for the product

name: platform_item_name
definition: Platform item name; crosswalk name match
help: Product name as the platform lists it

name: ean
help: Product barcode; links products across files

name: po_qty_ordered
help: Units the platform ordered on its PO

name: po_qty_received
help: Units the platform received (GRN)

name: po_qty_open
help: Units still due on open POs

name: po_expected_date
help: Date the platform expects delivery

name: po_expiry_date
help: Date the purchase order expires

name: unit_cost
help: Price the platform pays per unit

name: snapshot_date
help: Date the stock figures were taken

name: stock_city
help: City of the warehouse holding the stock

name: soh_units
help: Units in platform warehouses and dark stores

name: run_rate
help: Units sold per day at the platform

name: doh
help: How many days the stock lasts at the run rate

name: market_date
help: Day the market figures are for

name: variant_id
help: Dcluttr's ID for a product variant

name: brand
help: Brand of the product in market data

name: category
help: Category the product sits in on the platform

name: product_name
help: Product name in market data

name: pack_size
help: Pack size, such as 100 g or 500 ml

name: sales_value_mrp
help: Estimated daily sales at MRP (Dcluttr)

name: sales_value_sp
definition: Estimated daily sales at selling price
help: Estimated daily sales at selling price (Dcluttr)

name: selling_price
help: Price the shopper paid that day

name: discount_pct
help: Weighted discount off MRP that day

name: osa_pct
help: Share of dark stores with the product in stock

name: category_share_mrp
help: The product's share of category sales at MRP

name: category_share_sp
help: The product's share of category sales at selling price

name: market_city
definition: City column in market data when present
help: City the market figures are for, when given

name: case_size
help: Units per case; orders round up to whole cases

name: moq
help: Smallest order the platform accepts

name: plan_category
help: Category used to group SKUs in the plan
